record.question: Four people witnessed a mugging. Each gave a different description of the mugger. Which description is probably right?
options: He was average height, thin, and middle-aged.
He was tall, thin, and middle-aged.
He was tall, thin, and young.
He was tall, of average weight, and middle-aged.
record.explanation: Option (b) 'tall, thin, and middle-aged' shares the most features with the other three descriptions (tall in three, thin in three, middle-aged in three), so it is the most probable consensus description. The item is a reasoning puzzle without a fixed factual source, so confidence is medium.
